$comment: Story 6.30 (2026-10-10-312 AL11) — the plain fallback page at /peer-request, shown on a phone WITHOUT the app. Static words only: it never reads the link's code and shows nothing about any member, any death or any claim. The app is never named by a hard-coded brand — the name, when shown, comes from the APP_DISPLAY_NAME env value (body.open_named_app); otherwise the words say 'the app'. 'your message', never 'your text' (the WhatsApp reminder carries the same link). No helpline number here — the message carries it.
body.open_app: Please open the app to answer.
body.open_named_app: Please open the {app_name} app to answer.
body.home_screen: The request is also on your app's home screen.
body.no_app: Don't have the app? Install it, then open the link in your message again — or call the helpline number in your message.
